## T06 second-stage contract recheck — FAIL

**Blocking 1 · should_fix 1.** Focused tests passed **88/88** (74 metrics and 14 team). Independent changed-case probes matched **57/60** expectations across 90 source CLI invocations. This was a fresh Codex review using the same OpenAI provider. [Run summary](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/summary.json)

### Findings

1. **Blocking · T-4. `project finish P001` accepts visually empty cells when the filler is a Markdown link label.** A summary containing `[\u3164](details.md)` and a header containing `[\u2800](details.md)` each returned **0**, expected **1**. These fixtures use literal Unicode characters. Local Markdown rendering confirmed that the filler is the only rendered text in each cell. The validator checks the raw cell, so link punctuation and the destination supply apparent content. Plain filler cells and filler in the required `TEAM-RETROSPECTIVE.json` link label were rejected. A visible Hangul link passed. [Validator](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:41) · [Summary repro](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/md-filler-only-summary-link/filler-only-summary-link.md:23) · [Header repro](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/md-filler-only-header-link/filler-only-header-link.md:21) · [Rendered cells](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/markdown-render.log)
2. **Should fix · T-1. The shared stats and METRICS formatter prints the boundary hold note when the boundary count is zero.** In the closed positive control, text stats showed `총량 1` and `비교 미해결 0`, then printed `0건(미확인에 포함, 총량/방향 보류)`. The actual boundary control showed `1건` and an unknown total as expected. The JSON totals and comparison decisions were correct. [Formatter](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-metrics-document.ts:11) · [Paired CLI outputs](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/text-results.json)

### Criteria matrix

| Criterion | Independent result |
|---|---|
| **T-1 · Request measurement** | **Achieved numerically.** Valid in-period answers for roots before or after the window produced one `crossBoundaryObserved`, linked and unconfirmed, with reach totals `null`. Repeated events and IDs deduplicated. An answer after the window stayed outside the cohort result. Same-period answers established reach. The unwindowed handoff report retained its classifications. The text finding above remains. [Source](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/handoff-report.ts:29) · [Raw assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/results.json) |
| **T-2 · Period observations** | **Achieved.** An older-root request retained one in-period maker status and two valid failed attempts. Maker stayed out of unused candidates, and `finish` rejected `observed-none`. A confirmed same-period coordinator answer reduced comparison uncertainty only for its own request. The boundary request still held the total. [Source](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-metrics.ts:114) · [Ledger stats](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/ledger/ledger-continued-in-period.json) · [Finish rejection](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/ledger/observed-none-held.finish.json) |
| **T-3 · Comparison and legacy** | **Achieved.** A two-before/two-after stats-derived comparison returned `unknown`, with two unresolved after requests, a null reach delta, reasons and a sample plan. The matched clean control returned `observed-burden-improvement` (4 → 2). Focused replay covered the T01 legacy adapter, `owner` with existing `by:user`, and valid old responsibility prose. All three original T01 evidence files matched their `HEAD` byte hashes. [Boundary comparison](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/requests/compare-boundary.json) · [Clean comparison](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/requests/compare-clean.json) · [T01 hashes](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/t01-sha256.log) |
| **T-4 · Retrospective gate** | **Unmet.** Direct LF and CRLF cases confirmed that embedded U+2028/U+2029 neither open nor end a section, and a heading with trailing separator or additional text is rejected. Focused replay covered ASCII fences and escape-aware contiguous tables. The two empty-link cases above still bypass the gate. [Section walker](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:47) · [Raw assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/results.json) |
| **T-5 · Source CLI and acceptance** | **Synthetic workflow achieved. T06 acceptance remains unmet.** `start --role maker --agent codex --no-launch`, stats, comparison, METRICS generation and valid `finish` were exercised. The start recorded `runtimeObserved:false`, and role work time remained `null`. [Start event](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/role-flow/role-start.json) · [CLI transcript](/tmp/pace-t06-r21-recheck.sKQKTK/run/commands.jsonl) |

**Upper-goal alignment holds.** BR01’s reach definition and BR09’s ledger support BR06’s measurement contract and BR07’s retrospective input. P009 P-5 remains **unknown in the field**. T07 still owes its device and skill verification. T08 real adoption, efficacy and the live skill retrospective remain held for the user after main merge and installation. The full suite and broad native OS lock checks remain PM scope. The denied `ps` observation remains unknown. [P009 criteria and field scope](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/PROJECT.md:22)

I ran `node --test test/team-metrics.test.ts test/team.test.ts` on Node `v24.22.3` and used actual `node bin/pace.ts` commands in owned temporary Git and `PACE_HOME` fixtures. I broadened the changed-case checks to link-wrapped fillers and zero-boundary output. The earlier 193-probe sweep was outside this run. The first custom run called `stats --write` before creating its required close file. I retained that run and corrected the fixture order before counting results. `impl-diff.patch` passed the reverse-apply check and kept SHA-256 `599b62b06829799a34587687368a0e87b178f73c41de2e87e509066d7baebebc`. The worktree status delta was confined to review evidence files outside the temporary fixtures.
